name: io.github.OxToF/watchdog-mcp
title: Watchdog
description: Who can change a Solana program or EVM contract, dependency advisories, scans. Paid per call (x402).

environmentVariables.name: WATCHDOG_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base58 key of a dedicated Solana wallet holding a little USDC, to pay Solana Watchdog calls. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHDOG_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hex key of a dedicated Base wallet holding a little USDC, to pay EVM Watchdog calls. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHDOG_BUDGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Maximum total spend per server process, in USD. Default 5.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHDOG_MAX_PER_CALL_USD
environmentVariables.description: Maximum single payment, in USD. Default 1.
